context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend ride APIs all work correctly. The routes page had infinite loading bug which was fixed. The control panel is implemented in routes.tsx renderRoute function (lines 359-440). Testing control panel UI requires being logged in and navigating to My Routes tab. The user user1@example.com owns routes 'seini' and 'Aa'.

rca_of_issue.root_cause: In routes.tsx, loadRoutes() function (line 226) returned early when authHeader was undefined without calling setLoading(false). This left the loading state as true forever.
rca_of_issue.fix_applied: Added setLoading(false) before early return when authHeader is undefined
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Always ensure loading states are properly set in all code paths, including early returns
